definitions.explanation: A cooperative financial institution that serves members within a specific local area, providing savings accounts, loans, and other banking services primarily to small businesses and individuals.

examples.english: I deposited money at the credit union.

notes:
A type of cooperative financial institution ({協同組織|きょうどうそしき}) unique to Japan's financial system. Unlike banks, {信用金庫|しんようきんこ} are member-owned and focused on serving local communities. Often abbreviated to {信金|しんきん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {信用金庫|しんようきんこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open an account at a credit union
- ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信用金庫|しんようきんこ}: local credit union
- {信金|しんきん}: abbreviated form

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧: bank (larger, publicly traded, nationwide)
- {信用組合|しんようくみあい}: credit cooperative (even smaller scale than {信用金庫|しんようきんこ})
- ⟦{農協|のうきょう}→農協：27727_noukyou⟧: agricultural cooperative (serves farmers specifically)
